source.note: known-divergences/tokenless-empty-forms.md, The difference: mermaid.js reads nothing for the empty string between the vertex id and the style, which this specification rejects; the line rule ignores the last `;`, and leaving the empty string out joins the spaces around it, so nothing follows for the reference input, to which mermaid.js gives the style `fill:#f00` instead of ` fill:#f00`.
